mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS gameId, progression_kind AS progressionKind, stage_min AS stageMin, stage_max AS stageMax, stage_label AS stageLabel, require_all_stages AS requireAllStages, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM public.game_progression_schema WHERE game_id = #{gameId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.game_progression_schema (game_id, progression_kind, stage_min, stage_max, stage_label, require_all_stages, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{progressionKind}, #{stageMin}, #{stageMax}, #{stageLabel}, #{requireAllStages}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id) DO UPDATE SET progression_kind = EXCLUDED.progression_kind, stage_min = EXCLUDED.stage_min, stage_max = EXCLUDED.stage_max, stage_label = EXCLUDED.stage_label, require_all_stages = EXCLUDED.require_all_stages, updated_at = NOW()
